volumeOwnership.label: dev.sealant.mend.installation
volumeOwnership.identity: SHA-256 of the persisted identity.env bytes
volumeOwnership.policy: Setup claims the anchor before creating other volumes or starting Compose. Reject mismatched ownership and existing unclaimed Mend data; never replace credentials to adopt it. mend-garage is claimed the same way when the bundle carries Garage; a generation without it (an install from before the capture store) verifies without it. mend-vm-images and mend-vm-data, which only compose.host-vm.yaml declares, are Compose's own volumes, not external: setup claims neither.

hostVm.when: Only when MEND_SESSION_RUNTIMES or MEND_SESSION_RUNTIME names host-vm. mend server setup writes the overlay into a generation whose saved config names it; compose.v2.yaml alone keeps the two mappings above, which a released Mend image checks.
hostVm.note: The overlay's SEALANT_DOCKER_VOLUME_MAPPINGS is the base two followed by these two, and it mounts both volumes into the mend container.

bootstrap.servicePrincipal: SEALANT_SERVICE_KEY configures the platform principal; Mend provisions each user through public @sealant/sdk users.ensure on first use
bootstrap.jobQueue: pg-boss inside sealant_control_plane (schema pgboss); created by the Sealant API/worker on first start

workspaceImages.note: Sealant builds workspace images through the mounted Docker socket and launches them from the same Engine by image id. No registry runs and no port is published for one. Each workspace is on a network of its own, from 10.233.0.0/16 (MEND_WORKSPACE_EGRESS_SUBNETS), and reaches Mend and Garage only through capture.sock and session.sock, which Mend serves in the workspace's control scope (MEND_EXECUTOR_CONTROL_ROOT). Workspaces never join mend_default.

derivedSecrets.note: Derived at render time from the identity, never stored in identity.env, so an installation's volume-ownership fingerprint is unchanged by the bucket's arrival.

captureStore.init: mend server setup/start run `garage layout assign`, `layout apply`, `bucket create mend`, `key import`, `bucket allow` through `docker compose exec -T garage`, idempotently, after `up --wait`
captureStore.sessionEndpoint: http://mend:3106 on the Compose network (not published)
captureStore.publicUrl: http://garage:3900 on the Compose network (not published)
captureStore.workspaceNetwork: a /28 network of each workspace's own, from 10.233.0.0/16 (SEALANT_DOCKER_WORKSPACE_EGRESS_SUBNETS); the Sealant 0.40.0-next.938 runtime joins nothing of the Compose network to it, never mend_default; the executor reaches Mend and Garage through capture.sock and session.sock, which Mend serves in its control scope under /run/sealant/sockets
